name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Rename the Chat Designer buttons and refresh copy that went stale as features were added. 'Generate Playlist Preview' is now 'Suggest Programming' (it never produced a playlist - it sets a Step 2 query, and 'playlist' already means a Navidrome playlist elsewhere in this plugin) and 'Design Full Station' is now 'Draft Whole Station' (it fills Steps 1, 2 and 5, not everything). The panel hint described only the preview path even though it sat under both buttons. Step 2's explainer did not list the Journey type; Step 5's did not mention Smooth Transitions or Time-of-Day Energy at all. Panel subtitles and the build-a-station overview updated to match.

Fix Design Full Station doing nothing. The new action was handled inside a branch gated to preview/push/chat_preview, so the button never reached its handler. It is now dispatched correctly, and drafting no longer requires a valid Step 2 first - which was the point, since you use it when the form is still empty.
